capabilities: Encrypt locked notes before they are written to disk
Store an image secret and a recovery file outside the vault
Optionally protect notes via Windows account protection started from settings
disambiguation: Not whole-vault encryption; only the notes you lock are encrypted, and the vault stays usable otherwise.
extras: Desktop-only; source is private and reviewed through Obsidian's Community Directory GitHub app; the README notes the plugin can read and write files outside the vault and that the Windows setup only runs when started from settings; the community listing was not yet published when the README was written.
problem: Obsidian stores notes as plain Markdown files, so any local AI tool or harness that opens them can read their contents.
summary: Encryption plugin that locks selected notes on disk so local AI agents and tools read ciphertext instead of plaintext.
